notes.title: MAJOR CONTENT UPDATE - 21 Advanced levels added
notes.content: [h1]MAJOR CONTENT UPDATE[/h1][p]Over the last few months I've been working on some additional levels. [/p][p]These levels are more difficult than the main story, and are meant for platformer-enthusiasts.  [/p][p][/p][h3][b]The length of the levels is AS LONG AS THE MAIN GAME (21 levels)[/b][/h3][p]To head to the advanced levels, go UP in the main menu, and enter the portal on the TOP LEFT.[/p][p]If you'd like to enter speed-run mode so you can insert your score into the advanced-level leaderboards, make sure to activate the timer first before heading into the Advanced Levels portal.   [/p][p]Also, a new hat! [i]Tips fedora[/i][/p][p]There is a seperate leaderboard for those who want to eternalise their score on the advanced levels. I went ahead and inserted my first score in there already :)[/p][p]If you haven't yet, buy the game at the following link: [/p]

notes.title: First Update For The Little Pixel That Could
notes.content: [p]Dear Pixel Enthusiasts,[/p][p]I'm happy to announce the first big patch for "The Little Pixel That Could". This patch contains the following:[/p][list][*][p]Advanced levels 6-10 have been unlocked[/p][/*][*][p]Visual indicators showing the availability of your dash[/p][/*][*][p]Death-animation [/p][/*][/list][p]The Speedrun competition is also finished. big congratulations to [b]En_Hakkore, [/b]for setting a new record on the leaderboard. Depending on interest, I will launch future (speedrun) events :)[/p]

notes.title: The Little Pixel That Could Launch
notes.content: [p][/p][p][b]Goodmorning platform enthusiasts![/b][/p][p]it's done, the 'release app' button has been pressed! The Little Pixel That Could is now live!![/p][p][/p][p] I hope you all enjoy playing it as much as I enjoyed making it. Future updates will come to the game, which mainly includes new challenge levels to play through, and also a speedrun-leaderboard once all challenge levels are released. [/p][p]If you're up for the challenge after completing the main story, try out the speedrun-mode! Just navigate to the credit screen (North of the main menu) and activate the speedrun timer and head back into the portal. I challenge you all to beat my current best time of 15 minutes and 15 seconds! in the spirit of competition, I'll also provide the first person who beats my highscore with a 25$ steam gift card. [/p][p]Goodluck! Also, if you did like the game and want to support me, leaving a review is truly the best way to do that.  Thanks for your attention and support, and hopefully we meet again on the leaderboards! Best, Keydos[/p]

notes.title: Getting Ready For Launch!
notes.content:
Dear Pixel Enthusiasts

I'm happy to announce that the game is almost ready to be published! 
The launch date is still set for the [b]7th of June, 2025[/b].

Currently the final art-pieces are being worked on and put in place, as well as the final polishes for the game itself. 

The game will launch with the full main story (21 levels). Addiitionally, the game will have 5 advanced bonus-levels for those enjoying a platforming challenge, in addition to a speedrun-timer + leaderboard for the main levels!

The next five advanced levels (6-10) are also almost finished, so expect an update shortly after the official launch unlocking the additional levels. 

I hope you'll enjoy playing the game as much as I enjoyed making it. 

Pixelated greetings
Robert
